data.title: Data collected

data.note: No data is sold or shared for advertising purposes.

purposes.title: Purposes
items: Provide and secure access to the administration interface.
Store your content and settings to enable preview and publication.
Diagnose errors and improve service stability.

intro.title: What is a cookie?
intro.p1: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, tablet, or smartphone) when browsing an online service.

usage.title: Use of cookies
usage.p1: At this time, Compoz Studio does not use any cookies for advertising, marketing tracking, or audience analytics.
usage.p2: No third-party cookies (Google Analytics, social pixels, advertising tools, etc.) are installed during your browsing.

technical.title: Strictly necessary cookies
technical.p1: Only cookies strictly necessary for the technical operation of the application may be used (e.g. session management, security, interface preferences).
technical.p2: These cookies do not require your consent in accordance with applicable regulations.
